scope: V2 with BF16 expert cache, update21 rank0, second captured microbatch backward tail.
attribution_method: GPU kernel -> CUDA driver flow -> NCCL CPU annotation -> enclosing GFSDP::post_backward_reduce unit. Exact owner identity is recorded in the CPU annotation.
overlap_method: Complete native stream7 kernel interval union clipped to each collective. Memcpy/memset excluded; stream7 kernels may include gradient preparation and not only mathematical backward.
limitations: These are reduce-scatter kernels of FP32 parameter gradients. Uncovered interval does not by itself establish removable step time.
Analysis identifies owners and local overlap; no scheduling intervention, speedup claim or source change.

queries.label: selected_tail_kernels
queries.sql: SELECT id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 dur_ms,arg_set_id,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.correlation') correlation,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') input_elements,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.Out msg nelems') output_elements,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.dtype') dtype FROM thread_slice WHERE id IN (43435,43466);

queries.label: selected_tail_launch_ancestors
queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (
SELECT d.id AS kernel_id,h.id,h.parent_id,h.name,h.category,h.ts,h.dur,h.arg_set_id,0 level
FROM thread_slice d JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=d.id JOIN thread_slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE d.id IN (43435,43466)
UNION ALL
SELECT a.kernel_id,s.id,s.parent_id,s.name,s.category,s.ts,s.dur,s.arg_set_id,a.level+1
FROM anc a JOIN thread_slice s ON s.id=a.parent_id WHERE a.level<25)
SELECT kernel_id,id,parent_id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,dur/1e6 dur_ms,arg_set_id,level FROM anc ORDER BY kernel_id,level;

queries.label: tail_local_device_overlap
queries.sql:
WITH targets AS (SELECT * FROM thread_slice WHERE id IN (43435,43466))
SELECT t.id AS collective_id,s.id,s.name,s.category,EXTRACT_ARG(s.arg_set_id,'args.stream') stream,
(s.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,s.dur/1e6 dur_ms,
MAX(0,MIN(t.ts+t.dur,s.ts+s.dur)-MAX(t.ts,s.ts))/1e6 overlap_ms
FROM targets t JOIN thread_slice s ON s.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset')
AND s.ts+s.dur>t.ts-100000 AND s.ts<t.ts+t.dur+100000
ORDER BY t.id,s.ts LIMIT 70;
